description_en: Batch receives up to 16 messages from a specified queue for consumption
description_zh: 从指定队列中批量获取最多16条消息进行消费
name: BatchReceiveMessage

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of messages to receive in this request
parameters.help_zh: 本次最多获取的消息条数
parameters.name: num_of_messages

parameters.help_en: The maximum polling wait time for this request, in seconds. Set to 0 for an immediate return
parameters.help_zh: 本次请求最长的 Polling 等待时间（秒）。设为 0 表示立即返回
parameters.name: waitseconds

DequeueCount.description_en: The total number of times the message has been consumed

EnqueueTime.description_en: The time when the message was sent to the queue, in milliseconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 000
EnqueueTime.description_zh: 消息发送到队列的时间，从1970-01-01 00:00:00 000开始的毫秒数

FirstDequeueTime.description_en: The time when the message was first consumed, in milliseconds (timestamp). If `DequeueCount=0`, this value is the same as `EnqueueTime`
FirstDequeueTime.description_zh: 首次被消费的时间（毫秒时间戳）。若 `DequeueCount=0` 则与 `EnqueueTime` 相同

MessageBodyMD5.description_en: The MD5 hash of the message body
MessageBodyMD5.description_zh: 消息正文的 MD5 值

MessageGroupId.description_en: The message group ID. This parameter applies only to FIFO queues
MessageGroupId.description_zh: 消息分组 ID（仅 FIFO 队列）

MessageId.description_en: The message ID, which is unique within a queue
MessageId.description_zh: 消息编号，在一个队列中唯一

NextVisibleTime.description_en: The time when the message becomes available for consumption again, in milliseconds (timestamp)
NextVisibleTime.description_zh: 下次可被再次消费的时间（毫秒时间戳）

Priority.description_en: The priority of the message. 1 indicates the highest priority

ReceiptHandle.description_en: The temporary handle generated for this message retrieval. This handle is used to delete or modify Inactive messages and is valid until NextVisibleTime
ReceiptHandle.description_zh: 本次获取消息产生的临时句柄，用于删除和修改 Inactive 状态消息，NextVisibleTime 之前有效

UserProperties.description_en: The user-defined properties in JSON format
UserProperties.description_zh: 用户自定义属性（JSON 格式字符串）

v1_parameters.help_en: The maximum number of messages to receive in this request
v1_parameters.help_zh: 本次最多获取的消息条数
v1_parameters.name: numOfMessages

v1_parameters.help_en: The maximum polling wait time for this request, in seconds. Set to 0 for an immediate return
v1_parameters.help_zh: 本次请求最长的 Polling 等待时间（秒）。设为 0 表示立即返回
v1_parameters.name: waitseconds
